name: appintegrations
description: Amazon AppIntegrations actions Amazon AppIntegrations data types The Amazon AppIntegrations service enables you to configure and reuse connections to external applications.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates and persists an Application resource.

subcommands.name: create-data-integration
subcommands.description: Creates and persists a DataIntegration resource.

subcommands.name: create-data-integration-association
subcommands.description: Creates and persists a DataIntegrationAssociation resource.

subcommands.name: create-event-integration
subcommands.description: Creates an EventIntegration, given a specified name, description, and a reference to an Amazon EventBridge bus in your account and a partner event source that pushes events to that bus.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes the Application.

subcommands.name: delete-data-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes the DataIntegration.

subcommands.name: delete-event-integration
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified existing event integration.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Get an Application resource.

subcommands.name: get-data-integration
subcommands.description: Returns information about the DataIntegration.

subcommands.name: get-event-integration
subcommands.description: Returns information about the event integration.

subcommands.name: list-application-associations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of application associations for an application.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Lists applications in the account.

subcommands.name: list-data-integration-associations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of DataIntegration associations in the account.

subcommands.name: list-data-integrations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of DataIntegrations in the account.

subcommands.name: list-event-integration-associations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of event integration associations in the account.

subcommands.name: list-event-integrations
subcommands.description: Returns a paginated list of event integrations in the account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds the specified tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates and persists an Application resource.

subcommands.name: update-data-integration
subcommands.description: Updates the description of a DataIntegration.

subcommands.name: update-data-integration-association
subcommands.description: Updates and persists a DataIntegrationAssociation resource.

subcommands.name: update-event-integration
subcommands.description: Updates the description of an event integration.
